content.title: What time is Venezuela vs Italy and how to watch the WBC semifinal
content.text: The victorious team will move on to the 2026 World Baseball Classic final against the United StatesVenezuela vs ItalyLAPRESSEThe 2026 World Baseball Classic is down to its final four teams, and one of the most intriguing matchups features Italy vs Venezuela in the semifinal round.To watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoVenezuela arrives after a stunning victory over defending champion Japan, while Italy continues its historic run with its first-ever appearance in the semifinals after eliminating Puerto Rico.Here's everything fans in the United States need to know to watch the game.What time is Italy vs Venezuela?The semifinal between Italy and Venezuela will be played on:Date: Monday, March 16, 2026First pitch: 8:00 p.m. ET7:00 p.m. CT5:00 p.m. PTThe winner will advance to the World Baseball Classic championship game on March 17.Where to watch Italy vs Venezuela in the U.S.Fans across the United States will be able to watch the game on TV or via streaming.TV channelFS1Streaming optionsFOX Sports AppFuboThe FOX family of networks is the official broadcaster of the 2026 tournament in the United States.Where is the WBC semifinal being played?Stadium: loanDepot ParkCity: Miami, FloridaMiami is hosting the final stage of the tournament, including both semifinals and the championship game.MLB - EnglishWorld Baseball Classic - EnglishWhat Time Is - English
